capabilities.body: E fa'anaho OpenAmer i te hō'ē 'ohipa, e rave i te reira ma te mau mauha'a mau — te fa'auera'a, te hi'opo'a itenati, te mau putu'ite, te tapa'o porotarāma — e e tāpe'a i tei manuia.
capabilities.title: Hō'ē tauturu e feruri 'e 'oe

capabilities.body: Tei ni'a i teie roro uira te mau 'āparaura'a, te mau ha'amana'ora'a e te mau hōho'a. 'Aita e mea e haponohia maori rā e ani 'oe.
capabilities.title: Tā 'oe mauha'a, tā 'oe mau ha'amāramaramara'a

capabilities.body: 186 reo, te tāta'itahi ma te pāpa'ira'a tā 'oe e tai'o mau nei. E ani te 'api mātāmua o te fa'anahora'a i tā 'oe reo.
capabilities.title: Tō 'oe reo, ma te tano

capabilities.body: E tāpe'ahia te mau 'aravihi nō roto mai i te 'ohipa iho, nō reira e poto noa atu te mau 'ohipa o te mau mahana ato'a ia tāmau 'oe i te fa'a'ohipa.
capabilities.title: Te 'aravihi e tupu noa

help: Hi'opo'a e e nehenehe teie roro uira e tū'ati i te itenati.
Ha'amata fa'ahou i te fa'aineinera'a — e'ita te mau tuha'a i oti e rave-fa'ahou-hia.
Ia manuia 'ore e piti taime, 'a hi'o i te mau buka tāpa'opa'ora'a; e fa'a'ite te mau rēni hope'a i te tuha'a.
failure.lead: 'Aita e tauiraa i fa'a'ore-noa-hia — e fa'aea OpenAmer i te vāhi i fa'aea ai, e e tāmau te raveraa piti mai reira mai.
failure.leadUpdate: Tei ni'a noa OpenAmer i te huru tahito e tē 'ohipa noa nei. 'Aita e mea i monohia 'āfa noa.
failure.openLogs: Hi'o i te mau buka tāpa'opa'ora'a
failure.title: 'Aita te fa'aineinera'a i oti

language.lead: E tāmau te fa'aineinera'a i roto i te reo tā 'oe e mā'iti i 'ō nei. E nehenehe 'oe e taui i te reira i muri iho i roto i te fa'anahora'a.
language.title: Mā'iti i tō 'oe reo

progress.lead: Fa'aineinera'a hō'ē noa taime: tē fa'auta mai nei OpenAmer i te mau mea e hina'arohia e ana e tē fa'atano nei i teie roro uira. E'ita teie mau 'ohipa e rave-fa'ahou-hia i te mau ha'amatara'a i muri iho.
progress.leadUpdate: Tē mono nei OpenAmer i te huru tahito. E vai noa tā 'oe mau tau 'ohipara'a, mau ha'amana'ora'a e mau fa'atanora'a.
progress.stepsComplete: {done} tuha'a i oti i ni'a i te {total}
progress.title: Fa'aineinera'a ia OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Tāpa'ora'a ē ua oti te ha'amaura'a
stages.config-templates: Pāpa'ira'a i te mau hōho'a fa'atanora'a
stages.configure: Fa'atanora'a i te mau tāviri API e te mau hōho'a
stages.dependencies: Ha'amaura'a i te mau mea tāpiri Python e hina'arohia
stages.desktop: Hāmanira'a i te fa'anahora'a roro uira
stages.node-deps: Ha'amaura'a i te mau mea tāpiri Node.js e hina'arohia
stages.path: Tāpirira'a ia OpenAmer i roto i te PATH
stages.platform-sdks: Ha'amaura'a i te mau SDK o te mau tahua poro'i
stages.rebuild: Hāmani-fa'ahou-ra'a i te fa'anahora'a roro uira
stages.repository: Fa'ahōho'ara'a i te vairaa tapa'o o OpenAmer
stages.update: Fa'autara'a mai i te huru 'āpī roa a'e
stages.uv: Ha'amaura'a i te fa'anahora'a fa'atere pū'ohu uv
stages.venv: Hāmanira'a i te vāhi 'ohipara'a mariko Python

cards.body: Ha'amata i te fa'anahora'a e fa'ata'a i tā 'oe e hina'aro ia ravehia. E 'ohipa OpenAmer i muri mai e e fa'a'ite mai i te hope'ara'a.
cards.title: Ha'amata ma te hō'ē pereota

cards.body: Fa'atanora'a → Fa'a'itera'a → Reo. 186 fa'atanora'a reo, e nehenehe e taui i te mau taime ato'a.
cards.title: Mā'iti i tō 'oe reo

cards.body: E riro te 'ohipa e rave-tāmau-hia 'ei 'aravihi — i te taime i muri iho, hō'ē noa fa'auera'a e nava'i.
cards.title: Vaiiho iāna ia ha'amana'o

success.command: 'aore rā, ha'amata i muri iho nā roto i te hō'ē vāhi fa'auera'a:
success.errorTitle: 'Aita i nehenehe e ha'amata i te fa'anahora'a roro uira
success.lead: Ua ineine te mau mea ato'a. Nā 'oe OpenAmer i teienei — i ni'a i teie roro uira, i roto i tō 'oe reo.
success.title: Ua ineine OpenAmer

bullets: E 'ohipa i ni'a i tō 'oe roro uira — e vai tā 'oe mau 'āparaura'a i ni'a i teie roro uira
186 reo, e tae noa atu i te pāpa'ira'a tā 'oe e tai'o
E nehenehe te mau mea ato'a e tauihia i muri iho; 'aita e mea e vai tāmau
welcome.lead: Tā 'oe iho tauturu. I ni'a i tā 'oe mauha'a. I roto i tō 'oe reo.
welcome.leadUpdate: Ua ineine te hō'ē huru 'āpī a'e o OpenAmer. E mono te reira i te huru tahito ma te tāpe'a i te mau tau 'ohipara'a e te mau fa'atanora'a ato'a.
welcome.note: Tau minuti noa i ni'a i te hō'ē tū'atira'a mātauhia.
welcome.title: Mānava i OpenAmer
